meta.title: Hoi An now in january 2026; boating & cycling!
meta.description:
Magic boat trip on the river, and cycling around Old Town. 
Then to the Light House on the coast, and cycling amongst deserted beach resorts along the coast to Ang Ban Beach. Really sad to see all those 
closed beach resorts, due to developer financial issues, land speculation,
oversupply of projects, and the covid pandemic.

comments.author: @TeacherPocahontas
comments.text: So Beautiful Bro, I am jealous. Take care x

comments.author: @truedestiny8038
comments.text: Yes. Hoi An is really special. Last week i enjoy it as well. Driving with a motorbike from Danang down. And luckily the old town part did not change much in last 30 years as I been there my first  time. Stil very much enjoyable and recommended.
